motivation: weather and scene identity are confounded
no untouched benchmark remains after exploratory error analysis
town_policy: Verify installed maps first. Allocate at least one supported unseen town to sealed lockbox; if unavailable, explicitly downgrade the claim and obtain another map before unseen-town acceptance.
map_asset_evidence: 2026-10-16: .umap files present under artifacts/carla/CarlaUE4/Content/Carla/Maps. No new town RPC/load/render probe performed during GPU training; file presence is not map runtime validation.
split_policy: Freeze route/group/seed/actor asset allocation before capture; no success-based scene reselection
Overlapping or connected route/visibility regions must stay in one split, including all weather variants and repeat runs
Do not random-split frames or camera views; disjoint actor assets and seeds where possible
Collect repeated weather/time conditions inside each split so weather is not a proxy for scene identity
Train-only statistics and augmentations; keep lockbox label metrics inaccessible to training/selection scripts
Record failures and fixes as new versioned captures, never overwrite unsuccessful runs
class_coverage: Before full capture, freeze per-class positive image and independent-positive-episode quotas using a pilot feasibility study. Large pixel totals alone cannot meet coverage. Require meaningful truck/bus/light-state examples in each evaluable split; do not invent absent-class AP.
modalities: RGB input, GT raw semantic/packed depth/instance labels, calibration and synchronized actor telemetry; follow detection_label_contract_v1.json
pilot_gate: CARLA off during training; after model run finishes, five-frame 32-sensor pilot, CPU/RAM/VRAM/disk estimate, known-actor instance ID verification, visibility QA, and source/timing/lifecycle regression before any long acquisition
training_capacity_policy: The current full-resolution RAM cache is scoped to the 1200/400-view pilot. Estimate decoded tensor bytes before v3; enforce a RAM budget and use streaming or fingerprint-keyed mmap/cache if weather repeats exceed it. Checkpoint and sample catalogs must remain versioned; do not assume compressed PNG bytes equal RAM demand.

capacity_estimate.note: Estimate bytes from actual pilot compression distribution and add logs/checkpoints/headroom; image count is a plan, not acquired data.

acceptance_protocol: Use v1.1 exploratory findings to propose perception gates, freeze them before collecting/opening the new lockbox, report per-group results and uncertainty only where independent group count supports it. Model improvements on known v2 test are development results.
